description_en: Queries DNAT entries that are associated with a Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeDnatEntries查询智能接入网关实例绑定的DNAT条目
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-dnat-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --sag-id sag-djgd0000000000000 --type Intranet --page-size 12 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDnatEntries

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SAG instance
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关实例所在的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the SAG instance.

Only SAG customer-premises equipment (CPE) instances are supported
parameters.help_zh:
智能接入网关实例ID。

目前仅支持硬件版实例
parameters.name: sag_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the DNAT entry. Valid values:

Intranet: translates the IP address to a specific internal IP address. This is the default value.

Internet: translates the IP address to a specific public IP address
parameters.help_zh:
DNAT类型，包含以下选项：

Intranet：缺省值，表示私网DNAT。

Internet：表示公网DNAT
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 实例状态列表的页码，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

DnatEntryId.description_en: The ID of the DNAT entry

ExternalPort.description_en:
The public port.

Valid values: 1 to 65535 and any. The value any indicates all ports
ExternalPort.description_zh:
公网端口。

取值范围：1~65535，any表示所有端口

InternalPort.description_en:
The destination private port.

Valid values: 1 to 65535 and any. The value any indicates all ports
InternalPort.description_zh:
目标私网端口号。

取值范围：1~65535，any表示所有端口

IpProtocol.description_en:
The protocol used in DNAT. Valid values:

tcp.

udp.

any: all protocols
IpProtocol.description_zh:
协议类型，包含以下选项：

tcp：转发TCP协议的报文。

udp：转发UDP协议的报文。

any：转发所有协议的报文

SagId.description_en: The ID of the SAG instance

Type.description_en:
The type of the DNAT entry. Valid values:

Intranet: the IP address was translated to a specific internal IP address. This is the default value.

Internet: the IP address was translated to a specific public IP address
Type.description_zh:
DNAT类型，包括以下选项：

Intranet：缺省值，表示私网DNAT。

Internet：表示公网DNAT

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 实例状态列表的页码，默认值为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，默认值为10，最大值为50

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
